scale: question scores 0..1; report percentages only as explicit presentation conversion

docvqa.official_server_identity: unverified: direct RRC evaluation script unavailable during audit
docvqa.normalization: lowercase, strip and collapse whitespace for edit distance; original uppercase string lengths for denominator

infovqa.official_server_identity: unverified: vendor source states official-site origin; direct original unavailable
infovqa.normalization: lowercase, strip and collapse whitespace for edit distance; original uppercase string lengths for denominator
infovqa.cross_dataset_note: same explicit local protocol; does not assert current DocVQA/InfoVQA servers have identical implementations

chartqa.numeric: relative error <= 0.05; percent suffix divides by 100
chartqa.zero: numeric target zero falls back to case-insensitive original-string exact match
chartqa.text: case-insensitive exact, no punctuation/answer-prefix removal or extra whitespace stripping

all_datasets.reference_answers: offline scorer only; never prompt/model inputs or calibration selection
all_datasets.old_prediction_reuse: rescore raw predictions under this exact metric contract; do not copy old scalar scores
all_datasets.selection_policy: never choose metric variants after observing quality differences
